scope: Scoring and recording contract; not a complete scientific study or gate admission
prediction_points: Every declared action, before its feedback; no post-outcome selection
world_order: Lexicographic binary vectors in sorted physical ID order
map_tie_rule: First lexicographic maximum; retain all exact maximizers
proper_scores: Full-world NLL directly from log probability
unsupported_forecast: Explicit abstention; no invented probability distribution
overall_proper_score: Available only if all planned points have distributions; answered-only mean is separately conditional
answerability: Singleton evaluator-declared complete support conditional on preforecast information
information_key: Canonical delivered past, current action and selected coverage; excludes case ID, hidden truth, family, future readings and current realized dropout
support_policy: No model-based support, no renormalization onto oracle alternatives, no uniform prior or Bayes floor inferred from support size
dropout_assumption: Predictable or outcome-ignorable; asserted, not verified by the collector
trajectory_exact: All planned full-world MAP forecasts correct with delivered feedback; not free-running rollout
full_world_nll_scope: Per-event predictive scores under delivered histories; not joint hidden-trajectory likelihood
role_pair: Two explicitly named equal-length episodes with the same IDs/anchor/coverage and every contact reversed; both entire trajectories must be correct
calibration: Ten equal-width joint-MAP confidence bins, conditional on supported forecasts; descriptive only
lineage: Declared duplicate-risk tokens are disjoint across train, selection, calibration and evaluation; views share physical lineage
costs: Actual checkpoint provenance, per-forecast wall/CPU time, path diagnostics and collector process costs; no automatic capacity/compute matching claim
unresolved_admission_requirements: Fresh externally authored and custodied challenge and complete conditional oracle support
Prospective scientific denominator interpretation and untouched challenge lineage
Strong controls and declared capacity, exposure and consumed-compute matching
Predeclared material-gain effect size, statistical test and calibration acceptance criteria
Evaluator-controlled participant isolation and independently recorded artifact commitments
All required original G1 criteria and independent evidence-reviewed decision
